observations: body L2-L5: the fractions are set at full size across the line spacing, as in the print. 366 − 77 = 289, 289 × 4 = 1156 and 632 + 1156 = 1788; the 77 days are those from 16 June, the epoch of Yazdegerd, to 1 September (p. 70, note 4). The bars between the numbers (10.2 pt in L2, 9.8 pt in L5) are minus signs.
body L8, L30: the heads of the notes on chapters 33 and 35 are set in the larger type of the heads; chapter 34 has no note.
body L9, L31: in the heads the dashes after «a)» measure 10.2 pt; those of «14–15» and «73–74» (4.4 and 4.7 pt) are transcribed as long dashes.
body L9: the addenda (Part I, p. LXXIV) add to this note a reference to Samps Puchar, cited in the notes on the tables, t. II, p. 72–77.
body L10, L27, L29: heavy brackets open and close Schiaparelli's addition (L10, L29); the dashes after «deduxisse.» (L27) and before his name measure 10.6 and 10.2 pt.
body L12, L21, L23, L25-L26, L34: the dashes of «al–Battānī», «’l–qarnayn» and «al–Bat-» are long dashes (5.3 to 5.4 pt).
body L14-L15: al-Battānī's tables of the Roman months (Part II, pp. 74, 87, 104 and 107) all begin with ādhār and end with subāṭ.

body L21, L24-L29: Part II, p. 72 gives for the year 1191 the Sun's mean longitude 342° 48′ 50″, the lunar anomaly 108° 20′ 0″ and the node 176° 23′ 0″, and for 1211 the Sun's 343° 0′ 0″: the numbers Schiaparelli calls round.
body L27: the first t of «motuum» prints without its bar, so that the word looks like «moluum».
body L36: «Alcabicii» here and Alcabitii in note 1 are both printed; kept as printed.
body L9, L32: a speck to the left of the head «a)» and specks after «astrologicarum.» are not transcribed.
notes_right L1-L2: the hyphens of «al-‘Azīz», «al-Qabīṣī» and «60-61» measure 3.1 to 4.2 pt; note 1 goes on here from the left column.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
